Fill every block CELL_FILL with an INK 3 px outline, so the centre block is the tallest (480 px), the left block second (360 px) and the right block the lowest (260 px). Write the stand number on each block in INK 64 px, centred on the block and 60 px below its top edge: '2' on the left block, '1' on the centre block, '3' on the right block. On the front of each block draw a time board 360 px wide and 120 px tall, centred on the block, with its top at y = 740: a rounded rectangle filled CELL_FILL with an INK 3 px outline, the label 'Min. Sec.' (INK, 34 px) in its top 38 px, and under the label an inset rectangle (BG fill, INK 2 px outline, 320 px wide, 70 px tall, top at y = 782) holding the time in INK 56 px: '01:56' on the left board, '01:55' on the centre board and '01:57' on the right board. On the top edge of each block stand one faceless pictogram of a child, centred on the block, filled GUIDE with no outline: a head circle of radius 34 px centred 170 px above the top edge, a rounded-rectangle torso 90 px wide and 80 px tall from 130 px to 50 px above the top edge, and two legs 16 px wide and 50 px tall at 20 px either side of the centre, ending on the top edge. Then, below the ground line, write in ANSWER (52 px) one tag under each block, centred on the block at y = 985: '56 seconds more' under the left block (stand 2), '55 seconds more' under the centre block (stand 1) and '57 seconds more' under the right block (stand 3). Draw nothing else new.
